# `ScopeHome`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mount park/home worker state.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, ScopeAM5::GoHome @0xf0050, PrintGoHomeMode @0xefde0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterparts present |

F family. The guider's go-home worker (started by scope_park) is named ScopeHome; its detail printer adds close (arm folded) to every event whenever the axle position can be read, and equ_mode on complete when a mode was requested. A client SHOULD use close on the terminal event to confirm the arm state. Emitted by the guider on TCP 4400 to every retained socket; the main imager process forwards the line unchanged onto TCP 4700 (the auxiliary imager process suppresses guider forwarding). The imager's factory-test logic listens for a terminal ScopeHome and then emits its own FactoryTestControl event. Arrival, success criteria and reply/event order are not established. APK consumers: the legacy home handler and the device-state home handler.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"ScopeHome"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | F state table: idle 0, working 1, complete 2, fail 3, cancel 4; an unknown internal code falls back to idle. A formatter's supported state is not a promise that every run visits it. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if a non-empty stage string is held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if state is working, or the timer was started (terminal states) | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or started with no end) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Ordered function-tree ancestry when included; a missing route is a legitimate branch. Not an address. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code; written for state fail even when the stored code is zero. Lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'. Cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Written for state fail, including a stored zero. Cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `equ_mode` | boolean | if state is complete and a mode was requested | - | Equatorial-mode flag of the requested mode (true for equatorial). Only on complete, and only when scope_park requested a mode. [READ] |
| `close` | boolean | if the axle coordinates can be read | - | True when the arm is folded, that is the first axle coordinate is at or below about -85; false otherwise. Written on every event of this function whenever the guider can read the axle coordinates, omitted when that read fails. INFERRED that the unit is degrees and the first axle is elevation. [READ (condition and threshold); INFERRED (degrees, physical meaning)] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Parking (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ScopeHome","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":2000,"close":false}
```

Event, complete - Parked (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ScopeHome","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":15000,"close":true,"equ_mode":false}
```
